header_sentences: See Antediluvian, Ark of Noah, Inundate, Nephilim, and Water.

contexts.text: Such a change took place after the Flood.
The end of the days of the Church was the time of the Flood.
It here treats of the sixth and the seventh posterity, which perished by the Flood...
The state of those in the other life who perished by the Flood. Described... Because they would be such in the other life... they all became extinct.
They became extinct of themselves, and were suffocated as with an inundation not unlike a Flood; and therefore their extinction is compared to a Flood, and... is also described by the Flood.
They who lived before the Flood were of such a nature and genius...
The Flood, the ark, and the things described in relation to them, signify regeneration, and also the temptations which precede it.

The Flood = an inundation of evil and falsity... (For) when the way for remains is closed, the man... can no longer be protected by the Angels, but is wholly possessed by evil Spirits... Hence the death of the antediluvians, which is described by a Flood, or total inundation. The influx of phantasies and cupidities from evil Spirits is moreover not unlike a kind of flood, and therefore in the Word passion it is called a flood or inundation.
No Flood is here meant, still less a universal Flood, but the expiring or suffocation of those who were there, when separated from remains... and thus from the Heavens.

The reason that both temptations and desolations are compared in the Word to floods or inundations of waters, and are so called, is that they are similarly circumstanced. It is evil Spirits who flow in with the persuasions and principles of falsity in which they are, and excite the like things with man; but with the man who is being regenerated they are temptations, and with the man who is riot being regenerated they are desolations.

The Flood of waters () = the beginning of temptation, because it here treats of temptation as to intellectual things, which temptation precedes, and is light... It is therefore called a Flood of waters, and not simply a Flood.
That a Flood of waters, or an inundation = temptation. Illustrated.
(Thus) it is evident that a Flood or inundation of waters = nothing else than temptations and vastations.

The Flood () = the falsities which still inundated the Church; for there is no Flood or inundation except that of falsities. Above, a Flood of waters = temptation, which is also an inundation of falsities which are excited by the evil Spirits then with the man. It has a like signification here, but without temptation, and therefore it is here called simply a Flood, and not a Flood of waters.
Similar things are represented by the waters of the Red Sea to those here signified by the waters of the Flood... And by the Red Sea, as by the Flood, is signified damnation and also temptation.
In his state before regeneration, he was... beset on all sides by evils and falsities, or by the waters of the Flood.
A year, as here applied to the Flood, does not signify any year, but a time not determined by certain years, and at the same time the state.
It then treats of the state of man after the Flood...
All flesh shall not any more be cut off by the waters of a Flood () = that they will not perish like the last posterity of the Most Ancient Church. Explained.
And there shall not be any more a Flood to destroy the earth () = that so deadly and suffocative a persuasion shall not come into existence any more. AC 1051.

At last, in the last posterity of the Most Ancient Church, which existed just before the Flood, hardly anything of internal breathing remained; and when at last there was none at all in the breast, they were suffocated of their own accord; but in some external breathing then commenced...

After the Flood () = from the time in which this new Church came into existence... For the end of the Most Ancient Church is described by the Flood, and also the beginning of the Ancient Church... AC 1257. AC 1263.
Two years after the Flood () = the second postdiluvian Church.
The Flood itself was the last judgment of the Most Ancient Church... AC 2118. LJ 46:2.
Then was the consummation of the Most Ancient Church, which is described by their state before the Flood.
The Most Ancient Church thus expired about the time of the Flood.
The consummation of the first Church is described by the Flood. DP 328:4. TCR 760.

This last judgment happened for the first time when the... Church which was most ancient perished in the antediluvians through an inundation of evils and falsities, which, in the internal sense, is the Flood.

As they were in the days before the Flood () = the state of vastation of those who were of the Church, which is compared to the state of vastation of the Most Ancient Church, the consummation of the age or last judgment of which is described in the Word by the Flood. That by the Flood is signified an inundation of evils and falsities, and the consequent consummation of that age. References.

And knew not until the Flood came, and took them all away = that the men of the Church will not know that they are inundated with evils and falsities, because in consequence of the evils and falsities in which they are they will be ignorant of what the good of love to the Lord and the good of charity towards the neighbour are, and also of what the truth of faith is...
I was thus instructed what is signified by the Flood in the Word, namely, that the last posterity of the most ancients... were entirely inundated by evils and falsities, and thus perished.
Spoken with some who lived before the Flood. DP 324:4.
One of the two previous last judgments is described by the Flood.
(The Babylonians) who were in the plains were inundated as with a flood. SE 5298.
Some (of the Reformed) were inundated as with a flood.
On the signification of the rainbow after the Flood.
As with those who at last perished in the Flood.
Such before the Flood perished in this way.
(Thus) immediately before the Flood almost the entire interior man was destroyed.
After the Flood man was as it were inverted. (Explained.)
(On the literal occurrence of the Flood and the ark.)

Therefore some will have it that this is what is meant by the Flood, namely, that they were suffocated one after another; for this Persuasive is of such a nature that it suffocates others, and thus takes away their breathing...
There is a Flood by which the modern nephilim perish...
That an inundation, and a flood -immersion in evils and falsities, and the consequent destruction of the Church. References.
The Flood = the end of that Church, and the last judgment, which took place when everything of the Church had become extinct.
The Flood by which the human race was then destroyed = direful falsities of evil, by which the posterity of the Most Ancient Church perished. AE 644:end.
The Flood = the devastation of the Old Church, that is, the Most Ancient Church; and also the Last Judgment upon those who had been of that Church.
Ath 49. DeVerbo 14:3. Coro 34.
